verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows general GitHub platform capabilities (Copilot agent mode, project management, CLI, REST API with permission headers) but nothing specifically documents an AI-native bulk-operation capability (e.g., an agent or API workflow explicitly for updating/closing/labeling many issues, PRs, or repos at once). Missing for 10: explicit documentation or example of bulk/multi-item operations, evidence of AI agents batching actions across many items, and any quality/reliability signal for such a feature.
